gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Balsamiq Sans draws bold, expressive lines with no pinched curves anywhere. Zen Maru Gothic follows underneath in a sans that never snags, so the loud heading hands off to a body that reads like one thread.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-ibm-plex-sans: Balsamiq Sans has the look of blueprint lettering, bold and expressive, with one constant line throughout. And IBM Plex Sans gives every bowl a wide channel, so its technical manner stays approachable beside that loose, confident heading.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-zilla-slab: Expressive tubelike lines make Balsamiq Sans loud and constant, while Zilla Slab stays sturdy and technical with broad openings. One is built to announce; the slab-serif is built to explain.
gen-gf-baumans-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk is clean and approachable, with no thick-and-thin modulation. Baumans above it is commanding and distinctive, its wrench-wide c giving the pair a clear leader and a quiet follower.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-alpino: A c like a crescent wrench opened wide gives Baumans its commanding, one-thickness stamp. But Alpino is cozy and casual, tall in the lowercase with curve endings kept well apart, so a long read feels relaxed.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk is neutral but lively, its bowls left unfinished on one side and its lowercase running tall. And Baumans, commanding in a single stroke thickness, gives a long read a firm opening to settle in behind.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-hind: Wrench-wide curves, one stroke thickness, all command. Baumans stands out, while Hind sits next to it as a neutral sans-serif with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and a steady, drawn-string line.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-nunito: Nunito brings big round lowercase bowls and terminals that finish well clear of the stem. Nunito is approachable and contemporary, so give it a little extra size to let those bowls breathe under Baumans.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Baumans carries a c like a crescent wrench opened wide, drawn at a single thickness. Pilcrow Rounded follows in a warm sans-serif with big counters and curves that refuse to close, while the heading earns its place big and short.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-quicksand: Crisp and commanding, Baumans sets a wrench-wide c against Quicksand's tall bowls like blown glass bulbs. Quicksand keeps its bar thickness identical, so a long passage glides along.
